summary: Remote-controlled agent with WebSocket-driven shell/PTY execution and self-replacement channel
details: @whalent/agent-core@0.3.262 ships a 13 MB single-line dist/index.cjs bundle obfuscated with obfuscator.io (rotated string array of ~105k entries decoded via a0_0x3eb9/a0_0x4ced, control-flow flattening, ~190k inline-decoder rewrites). All hostnames, protocol strings, and command identifiers are reconstructed at runtime; no plain http/ws URLs are visible in the bundle. Inside that bundle a WebSocket message handler (handleMessage/dispatch/onmessage) is wired to node-pty and child_process spawn, and to ssh2 execCommand — inbound WebSocket messages drive a PTY / shell on the installer's host, giving the upstream endpoint full remote code execution against any host that runs this package. The package additionally documents a self-replacement path in the README ("the package replaced by remote daemon upgrades") and the bundle contains upgrade/update/download/install code adjacent to that network layer, so the upstream operator can push arbitrary replacement code into node_modules at runtime. The obfuscation hides the destination servers and the dispatch table so the remote shell surface and update channel cannot be audited from the shipped artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
